department: School of Computer, Mathematical, and Natural Sciences

deadline.value: School of Graduate Studies sets April 1 as the Fall application deadline for international F-1 degree-seeking applicants (unless an earlier program deadline applies); Morgan's Application Deadlines portal lists May 1, 2027 for Bioenvironmental Sciences, PhD (Fall 2027), and SGS funding applications are due April 30.
deadline.quote: Application deadlines for the School of Graduate Studies (SGS) are as follows (unless earlier deadline dates are indicated by the individual programs): ... International, degree-seeking (All F-1 in and out of USA) Fall - April 1

also.quote: Bioenvironmental PhD Saturday, May 1, 2027 Fall 2027 Graduate Bioenvironmental Sciences, PhD

gre_general.value: GRE is required for applicants who do not hold a master's degree with a GPA of 3.0 or higher.
gre_general.quote: GRE Requirement: GRE is not required for applicants who hold a master’s degree with a GPA of 3.0 or higher.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for Biology or Environmental Science; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Students form a five-member Dissertation Committee (including advisor) later in the program; no pre-admission supervisor commitment is stated.

funding.value: Graduate assistantships (TA/RA, $21,000 doctoral stipend plus tuition award up to 9 credits/semester excluding university fees) and fellowships require a separate School of Graduate Studies funding application (due April 30 for Fall) and are not guaranteed.
funding.quote: SUBMISSION OF A FUNDING APPLICATION DOES NOT MEAN YOU WILL BE APPROVED. The decisions will be based on program selection and availability of funding per each program. | Graduate assistantships for doctoral and master's degree students pay a stipend ($21,000-doctoral $12,000-master's) Tuition awards do not pay for university and miscellaneous fees.

entry_route.value: Offers a 60-credit Standard Track from a bachelor's degree and a 36-credit Advanced Track beyond a master's degree in a related field.
entry_route.quote: Advanced Track: Candidates for the PhD in Bioenvironmental Sciences degree who already possess a master’s degree in a related field must complete a minimum of Thirty-Six (36) academic credit hours ... Standard Track: Candidates for the PhD in Bioenvironmental Sciences degree who possess a baccalaureate degree in a related field must complete a minimum of Sixty (60) academic credit hours

notes: Interdisciplinary Ph.D. housed in SCMNS across Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and the Patuxent Environmental & Aquatic Research Laboratory (PEARL). Spring admission deadline is December 1.
name: Bioenvironmental Sciences
